english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something becoming visible or simply showing up.
Use 出現 as the usual choice when something comes into view, notice, or existence, such as a cloud or a problem.
This is the all-purpose choice when something comes into view or appears.
Use this when an opportunity, possibility, or other option presents itself.
Use 出現 when something manifests or emerges rather than physically coming.
Use this for something becoming visible, appearing on a screen, or turning up at a place.

examples.english: They suddenly appear at the door.
examples.jyutping: keoi5 dat6 jin4 ceot1 jin6 hai2 mun4 hau2

examples.english: A problem has begun to arise in the system.
examples.traditional: 個問題出現喺系統入面喇。

examples.english: You can see a bright star emerge in the night sky.
examples.traditional: 你可以見到一粒好光嘅星喺夜空出現。
